full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media illustration presents a monumental man's profile facing left across a collage of narrow vertical panels. The background is divided into warm orange, ocher, parchment, and cool gray sections by thin ruled lines. At the left and center, the pale face dominates: a strong nose projects into the orange field, one dark eye peers beneath a heavy brow, and a fine mustache ends in a long horizontal curl. A pointed beard, deep facial creases, and short swept-back hair are built from black ink hatching, gray wash, and small exposed areas of off-white paper. His ear appears in a separate ocher vertical strip at center-right, making the portrait feel fragmented but continuous. A broad curved pale shape hangs above it. The far right strip shifts to cool blue-gray and contains the close head of a small animal, with one dark eye and pointed snout above loosely drawn reeds or thin branches. Near the lower left, a tiny full-length standing figure appears against the warm ground, surrounded by faint smaller silhouettes. A few small birds or dark marks punctuate the lower pale space. The surface carries stains, rubbed color, pencil-like construction lines, and small scattered ink flecks; it is not a smooth digital fill. Orange and mustard blocks warm the left side, while pale grays and blue-gray strokes cool the right. Dark crosshatching concentrates around eye, nose, mouth, ear and collar, making the face sharply legible against translucent color fields. Light seems to come from the pale paper itself, with the densest darks confined to the linework and layered shadows. The composition gives a huge close profile visual authority while the narrow divisions and minute secondary figures produce a restless rhythm of scale and detail.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介插画让一名男子巨大的左向侧脸横跨一组狭窄竖向拼贴分栏。背景由细直分界线切成暖橙、赭黄、旧纸色和冷灰色区域。左侧与中部是占主导的浅色面容：挺直的鼻子伸入橙色区域，一只暗眼从厚重眉下看出，细胡须在末端拉成一条很长的横向卷线。尖胡、深脸纹和向后梳的短发由黑墨排线、灰色水洗与露出的灰白纸面构成。他的耳朵落在中心偏右的另一条赭色竖栏里，让肖像显得破碎却又连续。耳朵上方悬着一块宽而弯的浅色形态。最右边的窄栏转为冷蓝灰色，容纳一只小动物的近景头部，一只暗眼和尖鼻露在草茎或细枝的松散线条上方。左下角一位很小的全身站立者立在暖色地面前，周围还有更淡的小剪影。几只小鸟或暗色记号点在下方浅色空域里。表面带有色渍、擦磨过的颜色、铅笔般的构建线和散落墨点，绝非光滑数字填色。橙与芥黄块温暖左侧，浅灰与蓝灰笔迹让右侧转冷。深色排线集中在眼、鼻、嘴、耳和衣领周围，使面容在半透明色域前清楚可辨。光似乎来自浅色纸面本身，最深暗部收在墨线与叠加阴影里。构图给巨大的近景侧脸以视觉权重，而窄分栏与微小次要形体造成尺度与细节的不安定节奏。
style_prompt_en: Mixed-media drawing combines disciplined ink hatching, translucent wash, rubbed pigment and visible paper tone. Narrow ruled divisions interrupt larger shapes without destroying their continuity, creating a rhythm of fragments and crossings. Warm rust-orange and mustard occupy broad stained areas; cool blue-gray and parchment whites open lighter intervals between them. Fine black marks gather densely along focal edges and soften into broken sketch lines, faint construction marks and scattered specks elsewhere. Flat stained color and carefully modeled gray volume coexist on the same surface. The underlying pale ground acts as a diffuse light source, while the darkest crosshatching gives small zones of sharp relief. Large close forms are counterweighted by tiny distant marks and generous unpainted areas, keeping the composition intricate but spacious.
style_prompt_zh: 混合媒介绘画结合严谨的墨线排线、半透明水洗、擦磨颜料与可见纸色。狭窄的直线分栏打断大形却不破坏连续性，形成片段与穿越的节奏。锈橙和芥黄占据宽阔色渍区，冷蓝灰与旧纸白在其间打开较亮间隔。细黑笔迹沿焦点边缘密集聚合，别处则松成断续草线、浅淡构建线和散落墨点。平铺的染色与仔细塑造的灰色体积共存在同一表面。底层浅纸色像漫射光源，最深的交叉排线在小区域带出锐利浮凸。大块近形由微小远处记号和宽敞未上色区域平衡，使构图复杂而仍有空间。
theme_en: A large bearded profile across narrow illustrated panels
theme_zh: 一张蓄须侧脸横跨窄幅插画分栏
name: Sergio Toppi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
